fields.statement: At 95ae54b2 ran go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(workflow-describe|describe-golden)$' -count=1: ok. The workflow-describe script describes the built-in build (build (builtin) builtin:build, start, on.pass ->, role builder models), a repo .rhiza/workflows/build.toml that shadows it (shadows builtin builtin:build, start only), and inc.toml whose workflow step includes build (includes build, step build/only command); for both build and inc.toml, --json is cmp-equal to rhiza api call workflow.describe; afterwards run ls lists no run and fold-ok passes. Read the diff: workflow.describe goes through the same resolveWorkflow/workflowResolver as run start, and its handler only reads files. Checked by hand with a scratch build in a scratch repo: a personal XDG build.toml wins and shows that it shadows repo and builtin, steps come out in order with on targets and verifier/critic/fixer roles with model ladders and prompts (review), and an md5 of every file in the repo (including .git) and the config dir was unchanged after describing. make test: every package ok; TestReadBudget failed with uniform slowdowns across all reads (show included) at load average 8.6 on 4 cores. Those are contention timings: the leaf adds no read-path code. make check's self-check failed only on rendered files for live sessions' untracked actor records (including this verifier's), none in the commit.
